By the time he reveals himself in the flesh, his transformed state has taken on a more grotesque and skeletal appearance.
Collective Empowerment: The Fire Devil has the ability to become more powerful based on the number of people who have contracted with it.
Desire Granting: The Fire Devil's main power is that it can grant others the ability to transform depending on what they desire.

During his fight with Denji, the Fake Chainsaw Man was able to merge with several members, causing them to snap out of their zombie-like states whilst also being fused together to form limbs for the Fake Chainsaw Man to use.
Fire Dispersement: The Fire Devil is able to quickly disperse from a location by using its flames.
Fire Imagery: The Fire Devil can create flames in which it can project images.
He can also control members of the Chainsaw Man Church through their own contracts with the Fire Devil.
His view of Justice seems to be based on "fighting fire with fire", as well as the consequentialist rhetoric spread across the Church.
It is later revealed the Fire Devil was inside the imposter's body from the very start.
It is unknown if they currently possess a full devil form, but they can sprout chainsaws from their heads and arms.
Similar to Denji, they can regenerate from any injury if someone pulls the starter on their chest, forcing Public Safety to cremate them to fully kill them.
The Fire Devil uses this ability when it shows Denji the story of the twin brothers through a flame.
The contract also allows Yuko to transform into a thin and gaunt being with an uncovered brain and tentacles instead of legs.
The contract with Yuko, who wished to punish the bullies who persecuted Asa Mitaka, gives her the ability to read others' minds and detect their inner thoughts and feelings.
The contract with a mysterious person, which gives him the ability to transform into a seemingly perfect copy of Chainsaw Man.
The contract with numerous members of the Chainsaw Man Church, which allows them to transform into partial copies of Chainsaw Man.
The contract with one of the Chainsaw Man Church elders gives him a warped figure with two heads, with one protruding on top of the other one.

The contract with the class president, who wished to have a happy ending with her teacher, gave her the power to transform her body into a blob of flesh with multiple heads, large muscular tentacles with claws-like fingers and superhuman strength.

This means in essence, The Fire Devil sparks the embers of what seem a false perception of "Justice" within its contractor's desire and gives them a form to reflect that said form of "Justice" they want to carry out, regardless of its intent.
Unlike with other contracts, the Pseudo-Chainsaw People lose their mind completely and behave more like zombies, killing and eating people they come across.
While in her transformed state, she is able to move very quickly, being able to attack in just seconds and she was capable to slice though Asa Mitaka's skull and flesh, killing her nearly instantly.
With the contract's power, the imposter is capable of going toe-to-toe against powerful Devils such as the Primal Fears and even the Famine Devil herself.
For unknown reasons before the twin brothers found the Fire Devil, it had sustained unexplained injuries, which the siblings proceeded to treat.
In this form, the Fire Devil appeared significantly diminished in size, with only the flame atop its head remaining visible.
It has two right eyes that pokes through the fire and none on the left side of its face, and its mouth resembles an arrow pointing up or a cross.
It wears a seemingly burnt robe.
Its face is surprisingly humanoid with the top half obscured by flame.
Its neck is surrounded in sticks resembling a campfire or a wooden pyre.
Its upper body is adorned with a jagged mantle of burning branches, charred wood, or skeletal twigs, resembling a crown of scorched remains from neck to surrounding shoulders.
The Fire Devil's true appearance is a tall devil with a flaming head.
The arms appear stretched and unnaturally shaped in a way that resembles ashen logs and its hands and fingers of dry wood.
Thin, flame-like or branch-like extensions emerge from its back, enhancing its demonic silhouette.
Beneath its seemingly dispassionate façade lies a vengeful and calculating entity.
It adopts the guise of the "Justice Devil", using emotional manipulation, such as recounting tragic tales of the twins it influenced—to provoke guilt or sway others to its cause.
It is ruthless in its methods, notably showing no remorse over driving its contractors insane through its power, ultimately causing them to lose themselves in a never-ending pursuit for justice.
It presents itself as a force of righteous change, yet its actions reveal a twisted obsession with vengeance and control, making it a dangerous and unpredictable adversary.

The Fire Devil holds deep grudges, as seen when it confronts Denji for his apathy toward the twins' fate, yet it acknowledges the inherent selfishness of Devils, highlighting its hypocritical morality.
The Fire Devil is a high-ranking Devil characterized by its calm, nonchalant demeanor and a manipulative, ideologically driven nature.

The Fire Devil prefers psychological warfare over direct confrontation, retreats strategically when challenged (as it vanished after the skyscraper collapse), reinforcing its role as a charismatic but treacherous figure.
When revealing itself to Denji, the Fire Devil shows interest in his strength after witnessing his defeat of the Fake Chainsaw Man.

All Four Horsemen are female, appearing as young women and/or girls.(Chapter 108)(Chapter 113)(Chapter 118)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146)(Chapter 195)
All Four Horsemen have uniquely colored eyes whose irides are split by concentric rings.

Though they differ from another appearance-wise and may change their shape upon reincarnating, they (at least while in the Human World) look fully human to a degree rarely seen with full-fledged Devils, to the point of being able to pass themselves off as humans without being found out and seamlessly integrate into society.
Whether the Horsemen's original forms in Hell are the same degree of humanlike is unconfirmed.

Yoru the War Devil was seen possessing a Nightjar bird taking the shape of a small, beige potoo bird,(Chapter 98) before subsequently possessing the body of a teenage girl (and being distinguished in said body by her ringed eyes and facial scars that manifest whenever she is in control).(Chapter 98)
Death is the eldest and most powerful,(Chapter 146) Fami (Famine) is the second-eldest,(Chapter 108) and Yoru (War) along with Nayuta (Control) are the youngest.

However, it is unclear how far these memories go: Makima, the Control Devil's previous incarnation, could remember the names of devoured Devils but admitted that she could not recall them beyond the sight of them fighting Chainsaw, and that even those memories were starting to fade;(Chapter 84)(Chapter 98) the next incarnation, Nayuta, appears to bear no memories from her predecessor's life.

The Horsemen are four particularly powerful Devils who take on the form of human females and consider themselves "sisters" 姉妹 shimai.(Chapter 108)(Chapter 113)(Chapter 118)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146)

The Horsemen seem to be the only entities in the world (Devil or otherwise) who still remember the names of the Devils devoured by Chainsaw Man, such as the Nuclear Weapons Devil, the World War II Devil, the Nazi Devil, and others.

Together, the sisters are presumably known to have engaged in a particularly brutal battle in Hell against the Devil most feared by other Devils: "Chainsaw Man".(Chapter 87)(Chapter 98)(Chapter 99)(Chapter 104)(Chapter 135)
While Nayuta is currently the youngest of the four as Makima's recently born reincarnation,(Chapter 97) it is not explicitly confirmed if Fami and Yoru are older than Makima was.
Death Devil at different points tried recruiting both Yoru (War) and Nayuta (Control) for her plot.(Chapter 131)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146)

Despite their past collaboration in fighting Chainsaw Man, the Horsemen sisters are not a cohesive unit, each member pursuing different goals and agendas that tend to clash, yet which as a commonality involve Chainsaw Man in one way or another: Makima, the former Control Devil, posed as a human Devil Contractor working for Japan's Devil Hunter organization, intending (after being the first to find Pochita) to bring the Chainsaw Devil under her control in order to wipe out her sisters, to get rid of their very concepts and (supposedly) create a better world;(Chapter 84) Makima went as far as to claim that she was a fan of Chainsaw Man's due to his incredible power and chaotic violence, to the point that she would not have minded being devoured by him herself.(Chapter 84)(Chapter 95)(Chapter 96)

However, Nayuta did, at some point, express a desire to join the Devils' side alongside Denji, finding human society fun yet suffocating due to its rules, though Denji was able to convince her not to.(Chapter 149)

Nayuta, Makima's reincarnation, was taken in by Denji (Pochita's current host) and did not care to involve herself with her sisters' plans, preferring to study like a human child while living with Denji (and also admiring Chainsaw Man, wanting to see him in action as a Devil Hunter).(Chapter 121)(Chapter 131)
The Death Devil, assuming the name of Fami, has seemingly dedicated herself to opposing the apocalypse prophesized by Nostradamus and, by her own word, save humanity from herself.

The real Fami, or the Famine Devil's current agenda is to save humanity through death, believing that death is salvation,(Chapter 196) as seen when she tried to "save" the Fake Chainsaw Man.(Chapter 196)

Though her true goals are a mystery, she has operated with the objective of wanting to prevent the apocalypse by ending her own life and enslaving her younger sister War to aid her in this endeavor (specifically wanting to empower both War and the Chainsaw Devil to be able to successfully kill her).

Yoru, the War Devil, originally intended to find Pochita and battle him again so as to slay him, in a revenge plot for him eating part of her (plus other Devils that contributed to War's power, like the WWII and Nuclear Weapons Devils),(Chapter 98)(Chapter 99)(Chapter 104)(Chapter 129)(Chapter 135) while avoiding her sisters (or at least the Death Devil as Fami) in the process.(Chapter 118)

Additionally, though claiming to want to save humanity from extinction, she appears consequentialist (like Makima) in so far as she is willing to wreak global havoc to do so and sacrifice countless lives;(Chapter 108)(Chapter 113)(Chapter 122)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 146) Death Devil also has (like Makima) been willing to heavily involve herself with humans to pursue her agenda, chiefly by forming the Chainsaw Man Church.(Chapter 132)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146)
As a shared quirk, the Four Horsemen are face-blind, with Death Devil stating that "we sisters have no interest in faces-human or devil".(Chapter 135)
By contrast, the Death Devil is very calm, mannered, and polite to everyone, but unlike Control she does not bother to hide her ill intentions for Asa Mitaka.

Death Devil, likely as a ruse to maintain the thematic appearance of Fami, appears to be partial to fast food(Chapter 131) and has expressly named Chinese food and pizza as good enough reasons for why human civilization should be preserved, which Nayuta agreed with.(Chapter 131)

Famine has a meek and taciturn demeanour, but also expresses a high opinion of herself as well as her powers, & wishes to use them to “save” humanity from their suffering via death out of pity for them.(Chapter 196)

Makima did mention to Kishibe that she was aiming to kill her sisters to better the world for humanity, though given her actions, the truthfulness of this statement might be called into question.(Chapter 74)(Chapter 75)(Chapter 80)(Chapter 81)(Chapter 82)(Chapter 84)

Makima heavily involved herself in Japan's Government's Agency Public Safety and, pretending to be human, almost always maintained an aura of compassion and politeness in front of people — that is, until she began betraying her closest subordinates in pursuit of her secret ambitions, at which point she revealed herself to be callous, domineering, and Machiavellian as befitting "Control" (not to mention the countless human lives that she was willing to sacrifice).

Makima was willing to utterly break Denji's spirit to make the boy her obedient slave, telling him that he ought not need to think for himself,(Chapter 81)(Chapter 82) and later openly stated that she sees humans the same way they see dogs.(Chapter 89)
Nayuta, in turn, seems to have inherited Makima's acute sense of smell.(Chapter 120)(Chapter 121)

Nayuta, the Control Devil's next incarnation, has several childlike tendencies matching her current form, in terms of behavior and speech, though she has also exhibited domineering tendencies and can be rather perceptive.(Chapter 97)(Chapter 120)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 146)
None of the Horsemen seem to have the common Devil desire for human flesh, eating human food instead.

She even suggested that Denji join the Devils' side together with her, noting that, while human culture was fun, the rules that humans impose are suffocating and would disappear if Devils instead ruled over humanity; Denji was able to convince her not to do so or kill any humans, however.(Chapter 149)
The Horsemen all have distinct personalities, notably maintaining a veneer of amiability towards humans despite ultimately being extremely selfish and looking down on humanity.

The Horsemen stand out among Devils not only for their scheming tendencies (especially in the case of Control and Death) but also their humanlike dispositions, propensity to pose as humans, and willingness to integrate into human society (and collaborate with humans, including their anti-Devil factions) in favor of their goals.(Chapter 1)(Chapter 108)(Chapter 112)(Chapter 113)(Chapter 122)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 132)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146)(Chapter 195)
The sisters also seem to have an affinity for bread.(Chapter 97)(Chapter 135)

Though seeming less overtly extreme in her attitudes towards humanity, Nayuta has still come to view Denji as her property(Chapter 120) and has, ultimately, admitted that she would not mind killing humans, believing that killing was fine for any Devil to do since it comes naturally to them and makes them feel alive.

War is loud, touchy, immature, belligerent, and desires war to engulf the world so as to recover her original strength and not be forgotten by humans.(Chapter 98)(Chapter 99)(Chapter 104)(Chapter 105)(Chapter 112)(Chapter 135)

Well before revealing her true nature, Makima hinted at the fact that instead of discerning faces, she went by smell,(Chapter 1)(Chapter 2) something later confirmed by Denji, who noted that Makima never actually remembered peoples' faces, including his.(Chapter 97)
Whether all the four sisters perceive others via scent is unknown.

Yoru likewise noted that she had not recognized "Fami" due to it being too long since she last saw her (or possibly due to her actually being Death),(Chapter 118) and both she and Death (like Makima) are apparently unable to discern Denji-as-Chainsaw Man from Pochita (in his true form) by anything besides color, despite them looking very different.(Chapter 135)

Haruka seems to be benevolent and prideful on a surface level; he has a habit of constantly introducing himself in an extravagant manner and he holds his position as president of both the student council and the Devil Hunter Club in high regard.
His devotion to Chainsaw Man is shown to be the main cause as to why he co-lead the Chainsaw Man Church as its "face," as he didn't have the same ulterior motives held by Barem and "Fami".
However, he can also be very demeaning to those he views as having no worth to the club, such as when he berates Asa for accidentally destroying her phone when she tried to help out.
However, his devotion to Chainsaw Man immediately lead to him turning back on this vow and he decides to venture further into danger just for the chance of meeting him.
However, when cornered in the aquarium he easily admits that his ripcord is simply a surgical implant and reveals himself to simply be a massive fan of the Chainsaw Man.
In fact, their plan involving the Fire Devil is shown to take a mental toll on him, and he swears to never get involved with Fami or her plans ever again.
It's also shown that he can be fairly manipulative, lying to others that he is indeed the real Chainsaw Man, likely in order to boost his own popularity.
When cornered in the aquarium he breaks down screaming for Chainsaw Man to save him, he is later also shown to be easily intimidated by others.(Chapter 132)
A week after the recent ongoing Fire Devil attacks, Haruka and the other Chainsaw Man Church leaders were captured and locked up within the Tokyo Devil Detention Center by Public Safety.(Chapter 157)
Asa manages to convince both Katana Man and the Nail Fiend to form a truce as both groups want to confront Chainsaw Man, which greatly distresses Haruka.
Denji then awakens and decides to find Nayuta first before doing anything else.(Chapter 163)
Denji, finally reaching his breaking point, brutally rips Barem's head off just as Pochita takes control of the former's body once more.
Even when Yoru tells him that Nayuta is likely dead, Denji refuses to give up but is hungry for sushi.(Chapter 164)
Haruka remains silent as Barem informs Denji of his plans for bringing Pochita back before witnessing Nayuta's severed head being served as a sushi dish.(Chapter 170)
Haruka watches Pochita leave the restaurant to battle the Public Safety agents lurking outside the building.(Chapter 171)
Haruka yells at Nobana to step away from the man.
He shows Denji's head to the others, shocking Asa as she realizes that Denji and Chainsaw Man are the same person.

Himeno was a very tall and voluptuous young woman with smooth and slightly unkempt neck-length black hair, turquoise-colored eyes where she wore a black eyepatch over her right eye.
She was usually seen wearing her suit with a black tie.(Chapter 10)

In the past when Himeno and Aki Hayakawa were assigned as partners through Kishibe, she used to have longer and straight hair that touched her shoulders, bandages over her right eye as well as a sling on her right arm (which she removed right after they began working together, but she still kept her hair to shoulder-length) and she was slightly skinnier back then.
The name Himeno means "princess, young lady of noble birth" 姫 hime and "field, wilderness" 野 no, possibly referencing her nature as both gentle and wild.
Himeno cared deeply for Aki whom she trained as a new recruit and had a close personal bond with.

Himeno even went as far as to pressure Aki Hayakawa into taking up smoking as a new recruit, citing the fact that Devil Hunters don't usually live long enough to suffer from the negative side effects of prolonged use of tobacco anyway.(Chapter 16)

Himeno had strongly internalized another old teaching of her master: that only Devil Hunters "who have a couple of screws loose" are ultimately successful, due to the general sense of unpredictability presented by their willingness to do unusual things to take down opponents.(Chapter 16)

Himeno motivated Denji by offering him a french kiss, implying that she's at least somewhat perceptive of the people around her and was willing to take unorthodox approaches in order to ensure the best possible results from him.(Chapter 14)
Himeno was shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her.

Himeno was shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person as she cared for the well-being of her fellow Devil Hunters, as shown by her desire to not betray Denji during their first mission together.(Chapter 17)
Himeno was shown to be very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter.
However, despite this cheerful presentation, Himeno also held an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work.
In a brief flashback scene, Himeno was shown to be very patient and tolerant to those that are suffering when a late partner's former girlfriend lashed out and slapped her out of grief.(Chapter 16)
In fact, Himeno considered the side effects of Aki using his sword bad enough that it would be worth sacrificing Denji to prevent.

She generally carries herself with upbeat body language and was capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations, such as the initial phase of her group's battle against the Eternity Devil.
She responded to a small and seemingly insignificant Devil by almost immediately using her Ghost Devil to subdue it.(Chapter 15)

She was shown to have a more stern side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates, as she swiftly took out Kobeni Higashiyama when the latter attempted to stab Denji.(Chapter 15)
This knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her master eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism.
This puts into perspective how much she valued Aki's well-being.(Chapter 17)
However, after a long time working together, she began to gradually develop feelings for Aki and she states that she likes Aki simply because he is cool, and most of all, he is a normal person.
It was implied that Himeno had kissed Aki back when he was a new recruit.
Upon being assigned as partners, Himeno's feelings for Aki were just those between teammates at first and she simply didn't want him to die.
After the mission succeeds, the team goes to drink that night and a drunk Himeno kisses Denji, but also throws up in his mouth.
During her final moments, she uses her remaining strength to help Denji recover pulling his cord one last time.

Himeno and Denji met after he was assigned to work with Aki Hayakawa's squad and they immediately develop a good relationship with Himeno promising Denji to give him his first kiss if he completes the mission.

Later, she takes him to her apartment and asks him if he wants to lose his virginity with her and starts taking off his clothes, but ultimately stops after realizing he is not interested due to having a crush on Makima.
She also states that, since she has a hunch that this will be a long partnership.
The next morning while having breakfast, they form an alliance to make Aki fall on Himeno while Makima falls on Denji, thus becoming friends.

While witnessing Denji's power as a hybrid facing the Eternity Devil, she remembered the words of his mentor about the Devil Hunters the devils are afraid most are those who can't understand, believing Denji could be capable of defeating the Gun Devil and assists him pulling his cord to give him more strength.
Arai was partnered with Himeno for half a year, she comments on him having a big drive, despite lacking in ability.
Himeno enjoys being in Kobeni's company, teasing her on multiple occasions and calling her a talented Devil Hunter.
Himeno is shown to dislike Makima and recognizes her manipulative nature, even calling her a "bitch" at one point.
She also acknowledges Makima's control over others, including Aki, whom Himeno cares for deeply.
This control is a source of frustration and resentment for her, as she sees Makima as an obstacle to Aki's well-being and her own desires.

Himeno is noticeably one of the few characters who is normally referred to by a name written in kanji while everyone else has their names written in katakana, even if the names themselves are Japanese.

As a Civilian Devil Hunter, Yoshida wears a casual outfit that consists of an unbuttoned light jacket and dark pants.(Chapter 62)
As a Public Safety Devil Hunter, Yoshida wears the standard suit and tie when performing missions for the organization.
Following the events of the Public Safety Saga, Yoshida starts wearing the Fourth East High School uniform in a tidy manner, buttoned-up normally, unlike that of Denji and Miri Sugo.
He has eight piercings on his left ear, though usually, only six are visible below his hair.(Chapter 62)
His piercings are likely a reference to his contract with the Octopus Devil.
There is a beauty mark under his lips.
Yoshida has mid-length smooth black hair that only reaches the top of his neck, dark eyes, and a slim face.
Hirofumi's surname Yoshida means "lucky, good" 吉 yoshi and "field, rice paddy" 田 ta/da.
It is also the 11th most common Japanese surname.
Also, while on his duty as a devil hunter he seems to be somewhat strict and serious, telling Fumiko Mifune to stay focused on her mission and not get distracted.
Although Yoshida always has a smile on his face, he is also ruthless.

And, on the other hand, he is capable of being Denji's best support and ally, which is seen when he offers to skip classes and go to watch a movie in the cinema to cheer him up and even set up a date for him.
From his interactions with Kishibe, he is revealed to be still attending high school.(Chapter 67)
He also attempts to force Denji into quitting his role as Chainsaw Man for good by threatening to have Nayuta killed.
He also knows when to quit; as it becomes apparent that Yoru has gained an advantage over him, and he can't harm her anymore, he flees at the first opportunity.
He also seems to have a disdain for death, asking if it is possible for Denji, as Chainsaw Man, to consume the Death Devil for the good of the people.
He even remarks by mocking the Eternity Devil that trapped him with his fellow members of the Devil Hunter Club that, thanks to its existence, he now appreciates life more in general.
He is also entirely capable of acting as the 'bad guy' if it helps him on his mission, taking Nayuta as a hostage by sending a special squad to her school or having Denji kidnapped at Public Safety.
His final moments, where he thanked and apologized to Denji, suggest a complex mix of regret, a sense of duty, and affection for him.
His nearly perpetual smile can vanish and devolve into a grimace on rare occasions, like when he becomes too frustrated by Denji's lack of cooperation and seeming stupidity.
In summary, Yoshida is a complex and conflicted person, torn between his duty as a hunter and his desire to be normal and form genuine relationships, as demonstrated in his relationship with Denji.
This side of him is demonstrated when he mercilessly kills Joey of the three Immortal Brothers in a back alley after showing up behind the surviving brother.(Chapter 57)

Whether this is a personal desire or the intentions of the organization he is part of is currently unknown, although he also questioned Fami about the Prophecy of Nostradamus, presumably wanting to avoid it.

While he was once willing to capture Denji and believed his actions were for the greater good, his last interactions and eventual demise indicate a deeper, possibly even friendly bond formed with Denji.

While visiting the school he went to, he expresses regret over not being a normal student and wishes he could have spent more time going to school, but due to his role in Public Safety, that made it impossible.
Yoshida enjoys watching people eat, which is further demonstrated with the few times he prefers watching, and not eating himself.(Chapter 213)
Yoshida is quite playful and mischievous and loves to have small talk with his opponents during battle.

Yoshida is someone who doesn't like to beat around the bush and prefers to get straight to the point, as seen when he meets Fami and immediately asks her about her next moves, even threatening her if she doesn't cooperate with him and Public Safety.

Yoshida seems to not have any kind of interest in brawls among fellow students, considering it pointless to see them as something more than just a fight between teenagers, which is demonstrated by being apathetic about a student who got hospitalized after receiving a punch on his face and only cared about it because Denji was blamed for that.

As a Devil, the House Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities.
It has the ability to disguise itself as buildings to lure unsuspecting humans inside and digest them without them noticing.
It can be compared to the body of a human.
The House Devil is a large inn in the shape of a cross.
House-like Digestive System: The House Devil functions like a living digestive system.

The house is its body, the entertainment room serves as its stomach, the corridor beyond acts as its intestine, and the kitchen door at the end of the hallway represents its anus, with humans being gradually digested as they pass through each room.
History / Master Detective Power and Her Assistant Denji

16 Devil Hunters are led into the House Devil's body including Denji, Power, and Kenzo, and over the next couple of nights it slowly digests them as they try to find out what's causing the disappearances.
History / Master Detective Power and Her Assistant Denji
Due to Denji being a Hybrid, he survives being partially digested and kills the House Devil after transforming.
History / Master Detective Power and Her Assistant Denji
With only Power and Kenzo remaining, Power accidentally strikes at the House Devil's heart while aiming for Kenzo and reveals who the true culprit is.
Not much is known about the House Devil's personality, other than the fact they are pretty sadistic like most devils and enjoy toying with and confusing humans before digesting them unsuspectingly.

By conjecture, the front door of the house is likely the House Devil’s mouth/esophagus, while the kitchen/end of the corridor most plausibly represents the rectum, the organ immediately preceding the anus.

The House Devil seems to derive its power from several phobias related to houses and the domestic environment: Oikophobia (from Greek οἶκος: "house"), an aversion to a home environment, and Domatophobia, which specifically refers to the fear of a house itself.

If there is not enough blood, the transformation will stop on the way even if they try to transform again, the armament will not appear even if you perform certain actions, or only the damage will recover and return to the human form.
Moreover, their regenerative abilities are limitless and they can revive if there is an adequate amount of blood to consume, even if their head is severed or their heart is removed from their body.
They are able to restore their health by consuming blood, like Devils and Fiends.
When transforming or disarming, the changed parts melt like mud.
However, it is unknown if the Devil inside the Hybrids can make a contract with other humans.
Like regular humans, and unlike Fiends, Hybrids can make contracts with Devils, as it is shown that despite having a contract with Pochita, Denji is also able to contract with the Blood Devil.
Certain actions act as triggers for Hybrid transformation, with each action usually referencing a part of the Devil a human is fused with (ex.
Denji transforms by pulling Pochita's tail like a Chainsaw start cord, Reze takes out a pin in her neck like a pin in a grenade).
It's unknown if all hybrids are capable of such a transformation or if it's a specific power of the Chainsaw Devil.
Later, Denji transforms into a more powerful form capable of using Pochita's Devil powers.(Chapter 222)
The main ability of a Hybrid is transformation into their respective Devil forms fused with their human form.
Their strength, speed, and durability are dramatically increased after the transformation, and they also gain the abilities of their respective Devil.
Their transformation usually affects their heads and arms, but skilled Hybrids can also transform their legs into weapons.

Although Hybrids can regenerate by drinking blood just like Devils and Fiends, they are also able to regenerate and even recover from fatal injuries by activating their trigger without needing to drink blood.
Although the actual name for the Hybrids has been erased by this method, the Hybrids themselves still continue to exist somehow.(Chapter 87)

Examples of this ability include when Denji split Katana Man in half, but the halves stuck themselves back together when Denji activated Katana Man's trigger by pulling off his left hand,(Chapter 38) or the numerous times Denji has been revived by having his cord pulled.
Furthermore, they are stated to be immune to the Chainsaw Devil's ability to erase concepts by eating their associated Devil.
Hybrids also don't age, as Quanxi, despite being at least as old as Kishibe, still has the same appearance after multiple decades, while the Whip Hybrid also claims to be almost 82 years old.
This is exemplified by Makima bringing back Reze and Quanxi, long after they seemingly died.
This makes Hybrids immortal, as unlike Devils and Fiends who go to Hell when they die, Hybrids will remain on Earth for seemingly unlimited time.

It appears that Hybrids are immune to certain Devil abilities, particularly those that would forcefully transform them - this is seen through Denji being completely unaffected by the Zombie Devil's zombie transformation, the Doll Devil's doll transformation, and (potentially) the War Devil's weapon creation.

Although the human is fully in control when transformed, the Devil inside them can also take control and turn back to their Devil form if their contract is broken,(Chapter 82) as seen when Pochita took over Denji's body and fully transformed into the Chainsaw Devil.
Besides Chainsaw, the others are collectively named as Weapon Humans 武器人間 Buki Ningen and were members of the first iteration of Special Division 5 under the supervision of Makima.
Currently there are eight known Hybrids: Chainsaw, Katana, Bomb, Bow, Longsword, Flamethrower, Spear, and Whip.

Currently, Flamethrower, Longsword, Spear and Whip refer to themselves as The Weapons ウェポンズ Weponzu and are members of the Chainsaw Man Church under the supervision of Fami, while Bow and Katana are working for Public Safety as part of Tokyo Special Division 7, leaving Bomb as the only Hybrid whose status is currently unknown.
Hybrids keep their human consciousness and appearance but can transform into Devil-human Hybrids through a trigger and manifest the supernatural abilities of their fused Devils.
In addition, nearly all of them lack visible eyes except for the Chainsaw Hybrid, whose eyes glow bright yellow occasionally, and the Bomb Hybrid, whose eyes glow emerald-green.
In rare cases, a human can fuse with a Devil and turn into a Hybrid.
The Chainsaw Hybrid has a chainsaw cord on his chest, the Bomb Hybrid has a grenade pin on her neck, and the Bow Hybrid possesses an arrow in her right eye socket.
The Devil is also able to reform into their original selves if the Hybrid tears out their heart,(Chapter 96) though this would presumably leave the human unable to transform.
The Flamethrower Hybrid has a trigger at his molar.
The Hybrid's heart therefore becomes both their source of power and weakness.
The Katana and Longsword Hybrids have their respective weapons manifested in their arms.
The Spear Hybrid has a spear he can pull out of his neck.

The main difference being that there is no merging between a human and Devil in this scenario and that people with a Devil transformation appear to become full-on Devils, and might need help to turn back into humans from an outside source, while Hybrids are considered to be neither Devil, human, nor Fiend and can freely transform.
The only known method of becoming a Hybrid is via a contract or surgery, in which the Devil replaces the human's heart.(Chapter 1)(Chapter 36)
The real name for the concept of Hybrids was eaten and erased by the Chainsaw Devil, but Hybrids continue to exist despite their erasure for unknown reasons.(Chapter 87)
Their triggers are all based on the weapons that give them their powers and manifest on various spots on their bodies.
There is a similar phenomenon called Devil transformations which, like Hybrids, is a human who can take on the form of a Devil as a result of a contract.
They are also visually different in that all seen Devil transformations have been more monstrous, while Hybrids retain a human shape with only a demonic appearance in the head area and arms.
Though their appearance varies from weapon to weapon, most of them take on a mechanical/metallic appearance, and all of them lack lips, exposing monstrous teeth.
Unlike the rest, the Whip Hybrid appears to trigger her transformation by making certain motions with her hands.
When they are not transformed into Devils, they are, with the exception of their triggers, indistinguishable from regular humans, unlike Fiends.
When transformed, the head and, in many cases, the arms are affected, while the rest of the body remains human.
A Devil and human hybrid is a term often used in other media to refer to the offspring born from a Devil and human and not some transformation or fusion later in life, but there are exceptions.
Even now chainsaws are mainly used as a tool to cut wood, not as a weapon.
In Chapter 103, a news reporter refers to Chainsaw Man as a "Devil-human", a term similar to one of the alternate translations for Fiends: "Devilman" or Devilmen.

In Chapter 135, the hybrid Denji is referred to as “Red Chainsaw Man” and the Devil who became his heart, Pochita, is referred to as “Black Chainsaw Man” and the two bear notable and distinct differences not limited to just color.

It is unknown how much the unique transformed form for each of the hybrids vary from the form of a devil that became a part of them, other than most of the hybrid’s original human body parts typically still being present even in transformation.

It would also be doubly questionable as to what would qualify as a weapon or not, as many things can be used as a weapon but have other uses and vice versa, such as how chainsaws themselves weren’t originally weapons but were made for .
Other Devils who have consumed or tasted Hybrids, like the Bat Devil and Fox Devil for example, say they taste bad.
The term "hybrid" is a widely accepted placeholder name among fans but they are more accurately described as being fusions/merges between an already existing human and Devil than a crossbred hybrid.
This is a reference to the by , which served as an inspiration for Chainsaw Man.
While a Hybrid doesn't necessarily have to refer to beings born through interbreeding means only, the term is most often used, in real life and in fiction, to refer to such.
While all the Hybrids currently seen are only weapon-based, it is unknown if only Weapon Devils can become a Hybrid or not.

As someone who creates music, I feel deeply honored by this opportunity.
I started creating this song without deeply considering who would sing it, but as I worked on it, I became convinced that it could only be Utada-san, so I reached out with an offer.
The moment Utada-san’s melancholic yet breezy voice merged with this song, I was so moved that I held my breath in awe.
As singer-songwriters who pursue our own authenticity, we deeply understand each other in some ways, yet we grappled with the contrasting aspects of our expressive styles.

Augmented Durability: In his Hybrid form, Katana Man is durable enough to survive getting thrown through walls and falling from buildings without taking any damage.(Chapter 26)(Chapter 37)
Augmented Speed: After transforming, Katana Man's speed is improved, allowing him to compete with Aki and Denji in terms of speed.
Augmented Strength: Katana Man's strength is greatly enhanced in his transformed state, allowing him to cut through solid walls with his slashes.(Chapter 26)
Blood Consumption: As a Hybrid, Katana Man is able to restore his health by consuming blood.(Chapter 50)
Even if he dies, as long as someone removes his left hand, Katana Man can come back to life in perfect condition.
He also managed to survive being swallowed by the Fox Devil.
He can also slash walls in the blink of an eye.(Chapter 26)
He can survive being bifurcated, getting shot and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils.

He is also strong enough to cut the Fox Devil's flesh and the reinforced uniform used by Public Safety members, however he was not capable of making a deep cut in the suit with just one slash.(Chapter 25)
However, Katana Man does not actually disappear when he uses this attack, meaning it is possible to block or counterattack this move and wound him.(Chapter 37)

Hybrid Transformation: By removing his left hand from his body and revealing a katana which emerges from the stump, he can transform into the Katana Hybrid form with swords emerging from his arms and his head.(Chapter 36)
If he gets injured while using this technique, the damage will take a few moments before it appears on his body, just like when he cuts someone with this attack.
Katana Man moves faster than the average human eye can see and he can use this technique multiple times in a row without any apparent drawback.
Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Katana Man is immortal and nearly unkillable.
Removing the katana from his arm will undo his transformation.(Chapter 38)

Sword-Draw Dash: Katana Man's special technique, it is a quick-draw sword technique (also known as iaijutsu) by crouching down low and preparing to unleash his swords, Katana Man can dash forward at incredible speeds and slash at his opponent as he goes by them, often appearing to simply teleport past them before his attacks appear on his opponent's body.(Chapter 49)
While this attack tends to only affect a specific part of the enemy's body, it does so with significant force, severing limbs or cutting the opponent in half.
Marksmanship: In his human form, Katana Man has used a handgun to gun down Denji, Aki and Himeno at close range.(Chapter 23)
Swordsmanship: Katana Man is a skilled fighter with his arm blades, able to clash against Aki and Denji and ultimately overwhelm them with his powerful slashes.(Chapter 24)(Chapter 26)

Katana Man has a harsh distaste for religion as well, believing his grandfather's idea that religion and idiots are making the world worse.(Chapter 160)
Katana Man is a selfish, cruel-hearted, stubborn, and rather unintelligent man who only cares about killing Denji and forcing him to apologize for killing his grandfather.
Katana Man's hatred for Chainsaw Man is enough that he will easily disregard orders from his superiors.
So, he proposes to go to a soapland to make sure Denji can regain his manhood having sexual intercourse and cheer him up.(Chapter 165)

Enhanced Durability: Kishibe could survive being thrown out of a window and falling hard enough to crush the roof of a car, though he did slow his descent by stabbing a knife into the side of the building.(Chapter 62)

Enhanced Reflexes: Kishibe has superhuman reflexes, being able to dodge a spear at point-blank range which was thrust through the door in front of him by surprise and react to incoming attacks from directly above him.(Chapter 31)

Enhanced Speed: Kishibe is an extremely quick fighter; able to dodge Denji's slash and counter-attack by stabbing him several times before Denji could react, and slash Power's throat before she could start her own attack.(Chapter 30)

Enhanced Strength: Kishibe is extremely strong for a human; he was able to pick Denji and Power up off the ground with one arm each and snap their necks with neither of them being able to stop him.(Chapter 29)(Chapter 30)
With simple punches he could break weapons formed out of Power's hardened blood.(Chapter 30)
Even when heavily intoxicated, he demonstrates sharp tactical thinking, capable of devising effective strategies on the spot.
Expertise in Hand-to-Hand Combat: Kishibe is highly skilled in hand-to-hand combat.
Futhermore, he was able to keep up in a fight with Quanxi, someone who is well-known for her unnatural physical strength and fighting prowess.(Chapter 54)
He also has great marksmanship, as he was able to throw his knife accurately down a hallway to hit Denji in the head.(Chapter 31)

High Intelligence: Kishibe is widely regarded as one of the most formidable Devil Hunters in Japan,(Chapter 30)(Chapter 67) having endured decades in a line of work where most people don’t survive beyond a few months or years.
Kishibe also masterminds the resistance against Makima and her growing dominance over Japan, putting together a complex, multiphase plan intended to send her back to Hell.(Chapter 83)

Knifemanship: Kishibe is very proficient at using knives in combat; after evading Denji's strike he repeatedly stabbed Denji in the back before driving the knife up through his jaw and into his brain, before slashing Power's throat.(Chapter 30)

This is evident when he takes advantage of Denji and Power’s abnormal resilience to lethal injuries, using it as the foundation for an intense training regimen that rapidly improves their combat abilities, enough for them to land hits on him, even if only barely.
When Denji attempted to attack him from behind Kishibe could spin and kick in a single fluid motion to strike Denji's head and leave him incapacitated.(Chapter 31)

Kishibe is a jaded, straightforward individual.

In the Book of Revelation, locusts emerge from the abyss after the fifth trumpet, not as a typical famine but as demonic tormentors, stinging people (those without God's seal) like scorpions for five months, causing intense agony where people seek death but can't find it, a symbolic judgment echoing Old Testament plagues but distinct from the famine brought by Famine (the Black Rider).

The Locust Devil fits within the insect-related devils alongside the Carpenter Bee Devil, the Cockroach Devil, the Mantis Devil and the Stag Beetle Devil.

In Japanese, the word Shihai is an umbrella term for several similar concepts relating to control, conquest, rulership and domination, etc. So, while in Japanese it was already clear what type of Devil she was as well as being a Horseman upon the first time her Devil type was revealed, the umbrella term would be lost in translation, and thus different languages would come up with different variations, such as Control Devil and Domination Devil being the most notable examples.

As a Devil, the Mannequin Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities.
It is unclear, however, whether the Mannequin Devil can create mannequins that allow it to use these abilities or can only use existing mannequins.
Mannequin Mimicry: The Mannequin Devil's main ability, which is to transform mannequins into doppelgangers of anyone who touches it.
Mannequin Possession: The Mannequin Devil is able to possess multiple mannequins that he chooses to control.

This ability, which allows the Mannequin Devil to transform mannequins into copies of people, can be considered the opposite of the Doll Devil's main ability, which can instead transform people into dolls.
Using this ability, it can jump from one mannequin to another to avoid being killed if one of his bodies ends up being destroyed.
Using those bodies, it can not only mimic the appearance of his original target, but also copy their abilities and read their thoughts to a certain extent.
The Mannequin Devil's true form is described as a tiny, battered doll binded together with black feathers.
When using its powers, it can mimic the likeness of anyone that touches one of its blank mannequin host bodies.
Afterward, the Mannequin Devil's true form is revealed and is slain by Quanxi herself, ending the threat.
It is revealed that the Mannequin Devil had fled into one of its mannequin hosts, this time taking on the appearance of Quanxi due to her touching the Devil when destroying one of its bodies.
It then attacks Kishibe and manages to brutally wound Minami using Kishibe's likeness to lure her into a false sense of security.
Kishibe and Quanxi both learn that the Mannequin Devil can control many mannequins that it possesses, as well as gaining the abilities and thoughts of those who have touched them.
On Minami's first Devil hunting mission with Kishibe and Quanxi, the three were sent to hunt it down.
One of the mannequins attempts to attack Minami but is swiftly knocked down by Quanxi despite having changed its likeness to that of Minami's.
Quanxi then swiftly defeats all mannequin doppelgangers around the area, with Kishibe barely managing to defend himself in the crossfire.
The Mannequin Devil decides to use Kishibe's likeness on its mannequins to finish off the duo as it is unable to fully mimic Quanxi.
The Mannequin Devil resided inside an abandoned factory, where a couple of children reported that they heard its inhumane voice within the darkness of the area.
When entering the factory, the Devil Hunters discovered multiple abandoned mannequins lying around the area.
Although not much is known about the Mannequin Devil's personality, it is shown to be sadistic and deceiving when attacking Kishibe, Quanxi, and Minami using their likeness for its mannequin hosts.
It harbors a strong desire to copy the appearances of those who come into physical contact with them.
In essence, pediophobia is a type of automatonophobia, as dolls fall into the broader category of anthropomorphic figures that cause anxiety in people with automatonophobia.
It is often confused with Pediophobia (from Greek παιδῐ́ον: "child"), which is specifically the fear of dolls.
The Mannequin Devil derives its power from Automatonophobia, the fear of anthropomorphic figures, such as dolls, mannequins, robots, and animatronics.

As a Fiend, the Nail Fiend can't make contracts with Devils and their powers are considerably weaker than those of their devil form.
However, they still have all the other standard devil abilities.
Hammer: The Nail Fiend also wields a hammer in battle, which they use to make their striking attacks.
Enhanced Physique: Similar to their partner, they can move at an extraordinarily fast speed, being able to disarm an entire squad of gunmen whilst dodging their every bullet.
They are also able to swing their hammer with enough force and speed to pin nails into concrete walls from a distance whilst giving their targets no time to avoid the attack.
In particular, there is a prominent crack on their right cheek, possibly as a result of the injury that caused their initial death, or one they sustained prior to it.
The Nail Fiend is dressed in the typical office worker and jacket attire of other Public Safety members.
The hair on the back of their head is medium-length and flares outward.
The left half of their face is covered by a long fringe that reaches down to their nose.
The right half of their face is mostly cracked open and showing only nail-riddled brain matter even though other organs should be present.
Their most notable feature is their face, which is completely split in half.
They are also always shown seen carrying a hammer which they use in combat.
They are also drawn with a predominant Adam's Apple, which is typically associated with men.
Despite this, their protectiveness of children does seem to be legitimate, as their distaste for the culling of Fire Devil-contracted children is what lead to them betraying Public Safety.
Flamboyant and jovial, they also strike poses during combat and involve elaborate flips and slides in their movement, and during casual conversation they rest a hand on their hip.

However, just like Katana Man, they have a major violent streak; most evident when they aggressively struck one of the children they were "protecting" just because they didn't speak politely, likely traumatizing the very children they claimed they were protecting the innocence of.
However, they don’t seem to find Denji's rudeness and grossness attractive in the slightest and they quickly lose interest in him.

In addition, they tend to treat dangerous situations with a casual attitude, such as calling the Chainsaw Man Church elder "arrogant" when he morphs into his Devil form, and due to being placed among the ranks of other powerful Devils like Katana Man and Quanxi, they likely have the skill and proficiency to justify this behavior.
Nail Fiend seems to find men sexually attractive, as evident by how they laid by Denji's side when he slept.
Similar to their partner, the Nail Fiend believes to hold some form of moral principals.

They often refer to other people with terms of endearments - such as calling the Church's children "moppets" or "dears" and Fami "the poor thing" when she was struck by Yoru - and they refer to themselves with unisex language and pronouns in the Japanese version.

Whilst Katana Man respected his grandfather's work as a mobster who only killed "when necessary" and claimed to feel guilt over killing those transformed by the Zombie Devil, his partner criticises the Church for training children to act as soldiers due to valuing their innocence, as well as calling Yoru rude for kicking Fami out of the way of their attack.

As a Devil, the Chainsaw Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities.

Being regarded as the Devil that Devils fear the most, the Chainsaw Devil is considered one of the most powerful entities in the series after the Primordial Devils and the Four Horsemen, being able to fend off hordes of Devils in Hell unscathed.
His first contract with Denji was that, in exchange for consuming his blood, Pochita assists him to pay his debts.
However, unlike most of the Devils, certain aspects of his personality have never changed.
It is confirmed later on as a real contract rather than the "promise" presented by a young Denji.
Later on, after Denji is fatally injured by the Zombie Devil, Pochita became the heart of Denji in exchange for Denji living a "normal life."(Chapter 82)
No matter how many times he was killed, he would always come back to killing other Devils.
Per the Death Devil's plan, she empowered the Chainsaw Devil along with Yoru, as such, he exhibits a significant power boost.

The hunt for his heart alone was enough to cause an international conflict, and even Makima, one of the Four Horsemen, considered herself inferior to him, needing the public's adoration to weaken and defeat him.
These include the ability to make contracts with humans, restore his health by consuming blood and revival into hell after his death.

After being defeated by Makima to save Kobeni Higashiyama and later being rescued by Power, Denji's contract was restored and Pochita reverted back to his heart form while Denji transformed back into his normal hybrid.
As a full Devil, besides his head, he has four arms with chainsaw appendages.

As shown with the recreation of Nuclear Weapons by the United States of America, it is possible to revive or recreate the concepts that he devours from scratch, reviving the fear that the masses have towards them and possibly reviving the Devils that he had devoured that embodied those concepts.(Chapter 210)

Barem Bridge speculates that chainsaws may have had many different uses originally, but Chainsaw Man repeatedly consuming Devils and erasing their related concepts eventually left the chainsaws' only use to cut down trees, with Pochita's concept erasure being a remnant of that.(Chapter 170)
Beam claimed that the Chainsaw Devil could use his chains to hook around buildings to move around quickly in the past, but this has yet to be seen currently.
Body Assimilation: Pochita can fuse with a human body, restoring it to full health in the process.
Chain Entanglement: Pochita is able to disconnect his chains from his chainsaws to wrap around his opponent's body.
Chainsaw Appendage: As an embodiment of fear of chainsaws, protruding from Pochita's head is a chainsaw shaped appendage that functions as an actual chainsaw.(Chapter 1)
Devil Erasure: The Chainsaw Devil is infamously able to consume other Devils, causing the "name" they represent to vanish from public consciousness while also erasing their physical existence.
Devil Transformation: Should Denji's contract with Pochita ever be broken, Pochita can possess Denji's body and return to his original form.
Due to becoming his heart, Pochita is able to talk to Denji telepathically.(Chapter 97)

During Pochita's battle with Yoru, Denji emerges from Pochita's body and claims that Pochita's strongest Devil powers have combined with his genius brain and thus, Denji transforms into a more powerful form capable of using Pochita's Devil powers.(Chapter 222)

Furthermore it seems to take the path of least resistance, for example when the Ear Devil was erased, all animals lost their ears, but objects related to the sense of hearing, such as phones, ear picks and radios, were recontextualized rather than destroyed.
He can also generate chainsaws from his legs.
He uses this to pull them closer to him.
He's able to capture multiple opponents with it.
In exchange for Denji living a "normal life", Pochita becomes the heart of Denji.(Chapter 82)

It appears that certain concepts erased by Pochita can be brought back into existence if the components of the original concept still exist: atomic bombs were recreated by the United States despite Pochita consuming the Nuclear Weapons Devil since the radioactive components and the armaments to craft the nuclear weapons still exist.(Chapter 209)
It is later revealed by Makima that this fusion occurred as a result of the contract.
It is unclear whether Pochita can voluntarily regurgitate all the devils he has ever consumed, or if he can only do this for devils he has recently devoured.
It was done on Denji, turning him into a hybrid.
Kishibe was unable to recall historical events or things such as the Holocaust, Nazis or nuclear weapons, meaning that the Chainsaw Devil at some point consumed their respective Devils.(Chapter 84)
Makima stated that he has killed her 26 times in this state.

Pochita can choose which consumed devils he vomits back up, as seen when he vomited the Snow Devil and Bitterness Devil to make Denji remember the concepts when he was at his lowest point.(Chapter 182)(Chapter 183)

Pochita still can transform into his Devil form if Denji removes the heart from his body, in this form, Pochita has retain a calmer personality and has two arms similar to Denji's hybrid form, however his arms are still covered with an armor.
Powerful attacks can force Pochita to vomit the devils he consumed and restore their concepts to existence.(Chapter 173)(Chapter 176)

The Devil does not need to be fully consumed for the concept to be completely erased from existence as there were multiple cases shown that devouring the Devil's head was enough to achieve this effect.
The erasure process can also be partial: after the War Devil was partially devoured, the concept of "war" has remained, but no more wars have broken out in the human world.(Chapter 104)

The form seems to be under the control of Pochita as it is shown that he remembers Denji's dreams and tries to fulfill the requirements of their contract by eating a hamburger and going on a date with a girl.
This ability is activated when the cord in his tail is pulled.
This demonstrates a potential limit to Pochita's powers.
Unlike everyone else, Pochita does not seem to forget the devils that he erased.

When an erasure happens, any object, creature or phenomena associated with the concept ceases to exist, as well as memories of it - however, the world immediately "adapts" to this absence, as if the concept had never existed.

When used on himself, Pochita's erasure ability can not only create a new world where he never existed like that of a reset, but also causing the existence of Chainsaw Man to cease.(Chapter 231)(Chapter 232)
He moves almost instantly, making it look like he is teleporting to his opponents.
He was also able to survive the onslaught of Makima's Thousand Year Spear attack, even when weakened by public adoration, though he was in critical condition thereafter.

Immense Durability: The Chainsaw Devil's body is incredibly tough, being able to survive sonic lashes, explosions, piercing attacks, massive concussive blasts capable of sending him into space and atmospheric entry burns with little to no major repercussions.

Immense Healing Factor: As a full Devil, Pochita's regenerative abilities are enhanced to the point that he completely regenerated his body from just his heart after throwing it from space without needing blood, even when suffering intense atmospheric entry burns.(Chapter 96)

Immense Hearing: The Chainsaw Devil is capable of hearing people from extremely far away distances, as shown when he complied to Makima's order to come at her and heard Kobeni's pleads for help while the latter was in the Family Burger Restaurant.
Immense Speed: As noted by Beam, the Chainsaw Devil was renowned for his amazing speed.
Immense Strength: As stated by Pochita himself, when he was Chainsaw Man, he was so strong that he couldn't do basic social interactions like receiving or giving a hug.

Later on, this ability of Pochita was used cleverly by Denji that he removed Pochita from his body by leaving his body without a heart and let Pochita regenerate completely to mimic Denji and fool Makima.
Later, while fighting the hybrids, his attack on Quanxi and Miri Sugo was so powerful that it destroyed several buildings and effortlessly decapitated both of them.
This is even more highlighted on his visit to the Family Burger Restaurant, where even small movements of his arms were enough to kill several locals, probably accidentally.
To avoid unintentionally injuring Kobeni Higashiyama with his force, he had to carry her using his intestine scarf.
When fighting Makima and the hybrids, he effortlessly assaulted them before they could even react.
When the Hell Devil was summoned to defeat Chainsaw Man, it couldn't even attack before being effortlessly dismembered.
After disappearing from his battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Pochita is reduced to a “near-death state”.
Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw, and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord.(Chapter 1)
In this state, he appears to be a small orange canine-like Devil with a chainsaw-like appendage protruding from the center of his head.
An intestine still connected to his stomach is wrapped around his neck, resembling a scarf or a collar.
He towers over regular-sized humans and possesses dark armored plates or scales that cover his entire body.
It can be used to carry people like Kobeni Higashiyama or impale opponents with brute force.(Chapter 83)(Chapter 86)

Pochita's true Devil form is of a large, muscular humanoid Devil with two forearms split at the elbow of each hand and a chainsaw protruding from each, with another chainsaw coming from the front of his head, similar to Denji's Hybrid form.
Unlike Denji, he has horns on his head and does not appear to have visible eyes in his true form, though this doesn't seem to affect his sight.
After making a contract with Denji, Pochita assimilates himself with him, fusing with his heart and becoming part of Denji's anatomy, thus creating a hybrid.
Denji's chainsaw cord is also directly connected to the top of Pochita's head.
In this state, Pochita is smaller, has lost the chainsaw on his head, all his appendages and both handles.
Pochita also has blood vessels connected to Denji.
Pochita however still retains his trademark cute canine face.

Pochita then took on a Hybrid form similar to Denji's to fool Makima, with the only difference being that his arms were covered in the armored plates or scales he has in his true Devil form.(Chapter 93)
This allows Denji to become Chainsaw Man by pulling the chainsaw cord in his chest.
When preparing to fight Makima, Denji removed Pochita from his body.

After replying that she believes a world without bad movies would be better, Pochita realizes that he has no choice but to kill Makima, demonstrating that he does not use his erasure ability lightly and that he only uses it against devils representing very deadly concepts.(Chapter 93)
By consuming the Nuclear Weapons Devil & partially consuming the War Devil, he also prevented any more wars from rising and the risk of nuclear armageddon.(Chapter 86)

By the end of the Academy Saga, Pochita willingly sacrifices his own being to create a world where he never existed to give Denji a chance to properly chase his dreams without being dragged down by constant trauma and misery.
Despite this, his love for Denji remained, as he was keen to fulfill his friend's dreams, and later even sacrificed himself to save Kobeni.(Chapter 86)(Chapter 89)
Furthermore, when Pochita disguised himself as Denji to fight Makima, he asked her whether she would eliminate bad movies from the new world she planned to create.

He also seems to answer the calls of help from humans and Devils alike, proven when he saved both Makima and Kobeni from their problematic situations, though he later brutally assaulted the former after completing his task.(Chapter 86)(Chapter 86)
He also showed that he knows Denji very well and is able to mimic Denji's personality and behavior to fool Makima.(Chapter 96)
He continuously communicates with Denji through dreams, warning him to not 'open the door'.
He willingly gave up his heart to Denji so that he could fulfill his dreams which Pochita loved hearing about.(Chapter 1)
However, after fusing with Denji, he is able to communicate telepathically with him.
However, even in this state he remembers his friend Denji's wish of trying a hamburger that isn't rotten and going on a date with a girl, which leads him to kidnap Kobeni Higashiyama.(Chapter 86)
In spite of being a devil, Pochita appears to have a form of attachment or respect for humanity.

Later, he tells Denji that he always dreamed of being hugged, but his strength made that impossible, implying that his murder spree at the burger joint was accidental due to him being unable to properly control his strength around others.
Pochita deeply cared for Denji after his life was saved by the human, despite the Devil's general hatred toward humankind.
Pochita exhibits a more erratic personality when in his true Devil form, as shown when he quickly murders anyone who expressed even the slightest bit of hostility towards him in the burger joint.
Pochita is even able to speak normally when he takes on a hybrid form similar to Denji's, with even Makima mistaking him for Denji.

This can be supported by the fact he has consumed various devils that are dangerous to humanity, such as the AIDS Devil, Arnolone Syndrome Devil, Light of a Star That Breaks Children's Minds Devil, Mount Hio Eruption Devil, Nazi Devil, World War II Devil and the Sixth Sense Devil.(Chapter 84)
Unlike most Devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.(Chapter 1)

Results were announced in the 26th 2020 issue of Shonen Jump.
Results were presented in a color spread depicting the winners at a beach wearing traditional Japanese school uniforms, which differ from the canonical ones worn by Asa Mitaka and others in Part 2.
The first popularity poll took place between February and May 2020, allowing users to vote once a day for their favorite character.
The total number of votes was 231,201.
This spread was later released as a jigsaw puzzle from Ensky.
Results were announced in the 29th April 2021 at Shonen Jump along with an additional one-page comics featuring the first character.
The second popularity poll took place between February and March 2021, allowing users to vote once a day for their favorite character.
The total number of votes was 620,045.
Characters from Part 2 were added to the roster of characters that users can choose from.
In celebration of the release of Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc, the third popularity poll took place from September 17, 2025 to October 21, 2025.
The results were announced on December 3, 2025 on the Shonen Jump website with the character in 1st place receiving a four-panel comic drawn by Tatsuki Fujimoto.
The total number of votes was 949,097 registered.
Users once again were allowed to vote for their favorite character from the series.
Mengo Yokoyari, mangaka of Oshi no Ko and Scum's Wish, was actually voted for twice in the first popularity poll.
She herself is a fan of Chainsaw Man, calling the series nerve-wrackingly good, and has made artwork for the series as well.
Shihei Lin, lead editor at Shueisha, thought it would be improper to put her name aside since people did cast votes for the mangaka, and so she was included.

As a Devil, Power possesses all of the standard Devil abilities, such the ability to make contracts with humans for a price, restoring her health by consuming blood, take over a dead human body and their consciousness, becoming a Fiend, and reviving in Hell after being killed.
Denji used her blood to create a Blood Chainsaw and disturb Makima's regeneration.
In exchange for promising to find and befriend the reincarnated Blood Devil, Power gave Denji her blood.
In her original form as a Devil, Power claimed to be greatly feared to the point where other Devils would flee from her scent, though this is quite possibly just boasting.(Chapter 5)
Right now, Power has only one contract, being with Denji.(Chapter 91)
After drinking blood of the Chainsaw Man, Power revived as a Devil from the small amount of blood that Denji have consumed.
After her transformation, she is also able to resist Makima's domination powers.
After the defeat of the Chainsaw Man at the hands of Makima, Pochita exploited this ability by letting the blood of her inside Denji's body consume itself.
Also as the Blood Devil, her regenerative powers are at a higher level than other Devils.
Blood Axe: Power can create an axe out of her own blood to strike down her opponents.(Chapter 232)
Blood Chainsaw: A chainsaw created from Power's blood, she handed over this weapon to Denji to stop the rampaging Devil.(Chapter 232)
Blood Dagger: Power can create daggers out of her blood which she uses to slice her targets, which she is proficient in dual-wielding.(Chapter 232)
Blood Empowerment: As a Fiend, Power is able to restore her health by consuming blood.(Chapter 30)
Blood Hammer: Power can create an enormous hammer out of her own blood which she uses to crush her opponents.(Chapter 5)
Blood Knife: Power can create knives out of her blood to stab or slice her targets.(Chapter 15)
Blood Manipulation: Power can freely manipulate the blood in her body to form weapons.(Chapter 5)
Blood Scythe: Power can create a scythe out of her blood which she uses to slice her targets.(Chapter 59)
Blood Spear: Power can create a spear out of her own blood and uses it to stab at her target.
Blood Transfer: Through a contract, Power can transfer her blood and life energy to someone, similar to Pochita's ability to assimilate Denji's body.
By placing her blood in bottles and hiding them in the area as traps she can make spears suddenly appear from the environment to take her opponent off-guard.(Chapter 31)
Her speed, strength, durability and blood manipulation abilities have been increased dramatically.
In this state, a single punch from Power has enough force to launch Denji into the ceiling.(Chapter 38)
It is shown that she sprouts additional horns from her head after drinking too much blood.(Chapter 39)
It was enough to completely heal the critically damaged Chainsaw Man's body.
Power can also distort her target's regenerative abilities by mixing her own blood.
She can also make smaller handheld versions.(Chapter 6)
She can also manipulate other people's blood through direct contact and is able to prevent them from bleeding out though she acknowledges that it is difficult.(Chapter 18)
She can regenerate herself from small amounts of blood even after her death by consuming the blood of the stronger Devil.
She can use this technique several times.
She is also proficient in dual-wielding these.(Chapter 36)
This technique is strong enough to halt Makima for a couple of seconds.

Thousand Tera Blood Rain サウザンドテラブラッドレイン Sauzando Tera Buraddo Rein: In her Full Devil form, Power can generate thousands of blood swords and spears from the blood surrounding herself, levitate and throw them to her enemies.
When Power drinks too much blood or drinks blood from a stronger Devil then her, her power drastically increases.
Enhanced Smell: Power has a keen sense of smell, recognizing the scent of blood from a distance, while Denji was oblivious, and following it in order to track down the Sea Cucumber Devil.(Chapter 5)
She can memorize and recognize specific scents, being able to detect Aki's presence from his smell alone, despite him being behind a door.
Enhanced Strength: Power is far stronger than the average human.
She can wield a massive hammer made from her own blood, kill a bear with little effort and crush the Sea Cucumber Devil's body in one swing.
She was able to disappear from the Katana Man's sight as he gunned down the Devil Hunters before landing an uppercut that he couldn't block.(Chapter 23)
Acting Skills: Power is an amateur actress, capable of faking her death by lying on the ground in order to fool Quanxi.(Chapter 61)
Knifemanship: Power demonstrates her skills on using knives during her fight against the Yakuza zombies, even telling Denji to admire her skills.(Chapter 36)
Her arms have red coloration from hand to elbow.
Her chest has an open rib cage showing a chest cavity full of intestines up to her neck.
Her head has a pointed appearance with a red color, sharp teeth, and two circular eyes with cross-like pupils.

Her hair color varies from blonde to pink in manga illustrations, even appearing dirty blonde in some official art, and appears strawberry blonde in the anime.
